name: haunted-station-floor-schematic
title: AWS Builder Loft, level 2: schematic floor plan
notice: SCHEMATIC, NOT TO SCALE. Redrawn from AWS's own stylised kiosk map of the Loft; our eight sectors are placed inside its six blocks, and apart from the entrance, the elevators and registration most of that placement is a guess. Not an architectural drawing, not for navigation.
source: AWS's own kiosk map at the Loft (photos taken 2026-10-28), straightened from an angled photo. The entrance and the elevators are Jarda's marks on the kiosk photo; other notes are from him, on site. Earlier hand-drawn plan (Figma hoMyQYoQfNspdNGmuqeijJ) used only as a hint for doors and neighbours.

space.orientation: As AWS draws it on the kiosk, top of the screen up. AWS does not say how this lines up with the compass, so do not rotate it onto the area map.

fields.position: verified = AWS's map or a public source | sketched = Jarda's on-site notes or sketch | assumed = a guess
fields.existence: verified | invented: whether the sector exists at all (scenarios/research/venue.md)

blocks.note: Tall left column, purple on the kiosk. venue.md lists meeting rooms and sound-proof booths under hack_floor_west, so the two are matched.

Long top band with a drop on the right, purple on the kiosk. Jarda marked the entrance on its top edge, about halfway across. Split into the lounge (left), the entrance (middle) and the catering and coffee bar (right) on paper.
Small dark-blue block on the inner edge of the Lounge band. The AWS Heroes panel and drinks fridge in photos 4 and 5 are in the eating area, so it sits beside the catering bar.
Teal L-shaped hall with stepped corner, along the left of the open middle. Elevators at its top end, registration at its corner (Jarda, on site).
Gold L along the bottom and the lower left, the long room with tables in photo 1.
Blue block at the bottom right, marked 'coming soon' on the kiosk. Treated as closed.

zones.label: Entrance
zones.basis: Jarda marked the entrance on AWS's kiosk map: an arrow into the top edge of the Lounge band, about halfway across. The Courtyard Entrance and its stairs are on the building's SW side (AICamp 2025 page, AWS startups page; may be dated). The width of the zone is a guess.
spots: the ID check at the security desk

zones.label: Registration
zones.basis: The stepped corner of Reception, next to the elevators at its right end. Jarda, on site: registration is at the corner of the hall.

zones.label: Lounge
zones.basis: The left part of AWS's Lounge block: seating and the curved world-map wall screen (photos 2 and 3). Where it stops and the entrance starts is a guess.

zones.label: Catering and coffee bar
zones.basis: The right part of AWS's Lounge block, next to the AWS Heroes Hub. Photos 4 and 5 show the catering counter, drinks fridge and Heroes panel in the eating area.

zones.label: Hack floor west
zones.basis: AWS's Training Rooms block. The east/west split of the hack floor is invented (venue.md).

zones.label: Main stage
zones.basis: The lower-left arm of AWS's Co-Working L, taken as the event hall (podium, projectors, rows of chairs). Its place within Co-Working is a guess.

zones.label: Hack floor east
zones.basis: The long bottom arm of AWS's Co-Working L: the room with tables, a coffee counter and windows in photo 1. The split from the stage is a guess.

zones.label: Network closet
zones.basis: Invented (venue.md). Put in the top corner of Training Rooms as a guess.

features.label: Courtyard Entrance stairs
features.basis: The stairs up from the courtyard are verified (SW side of the building; OSM steps w941650785). They come in at the entrance Jarda marked on the top edge of the Lounge band.

features.label: Street doors
features.basis: Glass doors at the foot of the stairs (photo 2 is taken from them), on the entrance arrow's edge. Nightfall steps 19 and 22 hold the line here.

features.label: Security desk
features.basis: A guard at a desk just inside the glass doors, with a digital kiosk beside it (photo 2). Photo ID is checked first (AWS Builder Loft page).

features.label: Elevators (from the 1st floor)
features.basis: Jarda marked 'Elevator from 1st floor' on AWS's kiosk map: the right end of Reception's stepped corner. The lobby has none. The scenario's freight lift is read as one of these.

features.label: Registration desk
features.basis: Registration desk at the corner of the hall (Jarda, on site); the spot inside the corner is a guess.

features.label: Rear stage door (R2)
features.basis: Nightfall steps 20 and 21 name a rear door R2 next to the SW stairwell. Put on the wall between the stage hall and the registration corner, so the way out runs registration, then across the open middle to the entrance.

features.label: Door to Training Rooms
features.basis: Door from Reception into the Training Rooms block. Assumed.

features.label: Stage
features.basis: Podium and projection screen exist (AWS renderings, photo 1). Place assumed.

features.label: Lounge side door
features.basis: Nightfall step 12: the lounge side door opens to hack floor west. The Lounge band meets Training Rooms along this wall.

features.label: Lounge main door
features.basis: Nightfall step 9 hangs a garlic braid on the lounge's main door frame. Placed where the Lounge band meets Reception.

features.label: Staff-only kitchen door
features.basis: Nightfall step 14: a staff-only kitchen door behind the catering counter. Placed on the inner edge of the band.
